title: Thought Distortion Hotspots by Type
dataSources: Mood entries (`daylio:entry`), CBT thought records (`cbt:record`), breathwork sessions (`breathwork:session`), and therapy homework items (`therapy:homework`).
app: Wellbeing journaling telemetry from Daylio exports, CBT thought records, breathwork apps, and therapy homework trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cbt:record
| stats count as records avg(distress_before) as avg_distress_before by distortion_type
| sort 0 - records
description: Ranks distortion typess by thought distortions.
value: A distortion leaderboard shows which cognitive habits are recurring often enough to deserve focused work.
implementation: Send thought distortions events to `index=personal` and keep `distortion_type` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of thought distortions by distortion types.
grandmaExplanation: It records which distortion typess stand out most for thought distortions.
